about_item: Ergonomic Office Chair for Work: S Shaped curve supports spinal alignment with breathable mesh, adjustable height, and Single Lock recline upto 135, delivering all-day comfort for office work
BIFMA durability standard tested: Rigorously tested chair for home use and study, supports up to 120 kg with BIFMA Class-4 gas lift, and durability proven over 120,000 recline cycles
Best-in-Class Comfort: High-density antisag foam seat, breathable mesh back and adjustable headrest deliver lasting comfort, making it ideal as a study chair and office chairs for home
Advanced Specifications: Soft 3-direction adjustable armrests and strong nylon base making this an ergonomic office chair ideal for work
Warranty: In-house manufactured office chair backed by a 3-year warranty, including free part replacement for any manufacturing defects.
